one_line: A literature review plus qualitative expert study on ISO standards (ISO 50001, ISO/TC 301, ISO/TC 67) and industry initiatives (IPIECA, OGCI, IOGP) for GHG/energy-management improvement in the upstream oil & gas sector, illustrated with offshore FPSO and oil-field energy management case studies; petrochemical refining is only mentioned, not the applied context.
